# AI provider marks

The Settings model selector uses these marks only to identify the provider beside each provider name:

- `OpenAI-black-monoblossom.svg` and `OpenAI-white-monoblossom.svg` come from [OpenAI's official logo package](https://cdn.openai.com/brand/OpenAI-Logos-2025.zip). The light and dark variants are bundled as supplied. OpenAI's [brand guidelines](https://openai.com/brand/) require marks to be used only in direct relation to OpenAI services and not in a way that implies endorsement.
- `Claude-symbol.svg` is the Claude symbol from [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claude_AI_symbol.svg), identified there as originating from Anthropic and available under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

Both marks are decorative. Accessible option names remain the provider's model titles.
